summary: Mint Inc Ltd filed a Form 6-K disclosing a related-party private placement. On May 18, 2026, it entered a share purchase agreement with Deep Vision Enterprise Ltd, a shareholder wholly owned by CEO Hoi Lung Chan, to sell 211,879 Class B ordinary shares at $3.01 each (HK$5 million total, $637,755.10), priced at the May 15 Nasdaq closing price of Class A shares. The board and audit committee approved the terms as fair. The Class B shares carry 20 votes each and convert to one Class A share. This is a routine capital-raising transaction, not a special situation, as it lacks elements of a tender offer, strategic review, or restructuring.
